body.title: Wire workflow execution owners
body.summary: Connect both workflow.run streaming and workflow.run.start detached execution to the shared workflow delegate. Use the existing driver callbacks and real stream or registry outcome.
acceptanceChecks: Stream stage and delta frames, token batching, tail and terminal payloads are byte-compatible. Detached poll frames, cursor and abort behavior are preserved.
Both entry paths report stage transitions and measured cumulative output with the declared unit when present. Nested grounding and controller steps do not create separate observations.
Observer loss leaves detached work active. Accepted completion, rejection and actual cancellation publish exactly one settled status. Cancel requests alone do not certify termination.

tests.name: S2 workflow progress preserves streaming frames and terminal result
S2 detached workflow preserves poll cursor and abort behavior across observer loss
